nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Yo {name}, you up? Pull up to Sankofa Square, by the subway stairs. Gotta talk to you about something.

choices.text: Bro, it's pouring. What's so important?

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Rain never stopped nobody from getting money, ahlie. Just come.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Bet. Don't take forever.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Say less. Hit me when you're free. And don't leave me on read like last time.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Finally. Sankofa Square, by the stairs. Come now.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: What's good? I'm in the middle of something, I'll hit you later.

nodes.speaker: Ma
nodes.text: {name}, beta, where are you? It's late and it's raining.

nodes.speaker: Ma
nodes.text: That boy... okay. Your Baba's medicine is ready at the Shoppers on Yonge. Pick it up before you come home.

nodes.speaker: Ma
nodes.text: Walking, in this? Okay, listen. Your Baba's medicine is ready at the Shoppers on Yonge. Pick it up for me.

nodes.speaker: Ma
nodes.text: Can you do that for me?

choices.text: Can Baba not get it tomorrow?

nodes.speaker: Ma
nodes.text: He's on night shift again. Please, {name}.

nodes.speaker: Ma
nodes.text: Allah bless you. Text me when you have it.

nodes.speaker: Ma
nodes.text: Beta, are you eating properly? Come home before midnight.

nodes.speaker: Ma
nodes.text: You'll always be my kid. Midnight.

nodes.speaker: Ma
nodes.text: Okay. Khuda hafiz.

nodes.speaker: Baba
nodes.text: I'm at work, {name}. Listen to your mother, okay? I have to go, the supervisor is watching.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Remember I said something real? I got a bag that needs to get to the garage on Victoria Street. Easy sixty.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Don't ask questions you don't want answers to. You in or what?

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: That's my guy. Bag's by the Sankofa Square subway entrance. Grab it, then the garage.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Your loss. Don't come crying when your pockets are empty.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: There he is. Look at you, {name}. Pantages Tower? Since when you got condo money?

choices.text: You dragged me out in the rain for this?

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Stopped wasting it. Okay, okay. Regent Park still remembers when you couldn't buy a patty.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Say less. Everybody downtown got secrets. I'm not the police.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Relax, it's Toronto, it's always raining. I'm here 'cause I need somebody I trust.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: I'm plugged in out here now. People need things moved, picked up, looked at. Small stuff, good money. You in?

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: That's my guy. Keep your phone on.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Smart. Nothing crazy. I'll call you, you decide. Keep your phone on.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: You didn't open it, right? Don't answer, I can see your face.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Stuff that pays rent. Less you know, less you gotta lie about.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Here. That's sixty. Go home, get dry. I'll hit you up.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Yo, you near the subway? Need you up at College. Take Line 1, it's quicker than walking in this.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Guy owes me, he's by College Park. I want you there so he sees I got people.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Bet. College Park entrance. I'll be outside.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Aight. Don't make me ask twice though.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Took the train like I said? Good. He just left. Saw you, got scared, paid up.

choices.text: That's it? I just stood here.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: That's the job sometimes. Presence. Here, forty.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Don't get comfortable. Here, forty.

nodes.speaker: Ty
nodes.text: Go home through the Eaton Centre, it's dry. Talk soon.
